<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-nice-qantas-cut-jobs" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/nice-qantas-cut-jobs/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="NICE and Qantas cut jobs months after saying they would not." markdown>

**NICE and Qantas cut jobs months after saying they would not.** NICE will cut about 500 roles (5% of roughly 10,000); its CEO cites R&D teams "leveraging AI tools to increase productivity materially" and the removal of "layers of management and span of control", after saying in July "We have no plans to reduce headcount." Qantas will cut around 850 back-office roles through an Accenture deal that moves most of the work to India first, with automation and AI to follow; its union says it was told earlier this year there was "no plan to offshore any jobs". In both cases the productivity claims are management's own. [CTech, 4 Nov 2026](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/ygubfbd9r) · [Information Age, 10 Nov 2026](https://ia.acs.org.au/article/2026/qantas-to-axe-850-jobs-in-ai-overhaul.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-dbs-governs-ai-agents" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/dbs-governs-ai-agents/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="DBS governs its AI agents like a workforce, through an &quot;agentic control plane&quot;." markdown>

**DBS governs its AI agents like a workforce, through an "agentic control plane".** Group CIO Eugene Huang says agents need the equivalent of an employee handbook: DBS runs them inside its internal environment, with controls over identity, authorisation and higher-risk actions, plus human oversight. The bank rolled out an AI credit-assessment tool to about 1,500 employees in August and says it has no plans to shrink its technology team; freed capacity will go to replacing legacy systems earlier. Executive interview, no metrics. [Lianhe Zaobao, 10 Nov 2026](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/en/finance/singapore/dbs-cio-eugene-huang-manage-ai-agents-give-them-employee-handbook)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-pwc-korea-blocks-external-ai" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/pwc-korea-blocks-external-ai/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="PwC Korea reportedly blocks external AI tools after document leaks." markdown>

**PwC Korea reportedly blocks external AI tools after document leaks.** A consultant there says ChatGPT now triggers a "harmful website" warning, after staff uploaded internal documents to external tools. The internal alternative "has the confidence of a partner and the research skills of me on my first day." The cause is relayed as "the explanation making the rounds" and is not confirmed by PwC. [Reddit r/consulting, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/consulting/comments/1xre1bw/pwc_korea_blocked_chatgpt_apparently_desk/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-microsoft-voluntary-buyouts" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/microsoft-voluntary-buyouts/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees while spending $175 billion on AI infrastructure." markdown>

**Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees while spending $175 billion on AI infrastructure.** The offer covers roughly a quarter of the global workforce, at vice-president level and below in the US, UK, Canada and India. Microsoft has not said AI replaces these roles; the link is the timing of the spending. [CBS News, 26 Oct 2026](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/microsoft-buyouts-60000-workers-artificial-intelligence-layoffs/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-bmw-pipedrive-cut-management" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/bmw-pipedrive-cut-management/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="BMW and Pipedrive cut management layers with AI as the stated reason." markdown>

**BMW and Pipedrive cut management layers with AI as the stated reason.** BMW plans to remove about 20% of senior management roles by mid-2027, its CFO citing agentic AI as the route to "leaner structures and faster decision-making"; the report does not say how AI absorbs the work. Pipedrive proposed cutting 267 jobs in Estonia, 70% of its local staff, because small businesses now ask AI for software recommendations and its search traffic has "declined sharply". [Business Today, 1 Oct 2026](https://www.businesstoday.in/jobs/story/bmw-to-cut-20-of-senior-management-roles-with-ai-as-it-pushes-for-cost-savings-559029-2026-10-01) · [Estonian World, 1 Nov 2026](https://estonianworld.com/business/estonias-pipedrive-to-cut-70-of-local-workforce-as-ai-disrupts-its-business-model/)

**McKinsey tests an AI-simulated client in entry-level interviews.** Citing The Wall Street Journal, The Verge reports that some undergraduate business-analyst candidates in North America will hold a 10-minute conversation with an AI client simulation this autumn. The AI does not score candidates; humans in the room assess them. [The Verge, 14 Oct 2026](https://www.theverge.com/news/1011654/mckinsey-ai-client-interview)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-societe-generale-ai-gains-plan" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/societe-generale-ai-gains-plan/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Société Générale writes €500–600M of AI gains into its 2026–2029 plan." markdown>

**Société Générale writes €500–600M of AI gains into its 2026–2029 plan.** The bank announced a partnership with Anthropic to deploy Claude at every level of the company, inside a €1.9bn gross cost-reduction target for 2029 that relies mainly on not replacing natural departures. These are investor-day targets, not results. Danske Bank made the same link that week: its headcount (19,472 FTEs) will keep falling as employees get personal AI agents by year-end. [Presse-citron, 22 Sep 2026](https://www.presse-citron.net/ia-et-restructuration-en-pleine-bourre-la-societe-generale-poursuit-son-incroyable-transformation/) · [Bloomberg via Briefs, 21 Sep 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/danske-expects-fewer-staff-as-ai-is-rolled-across-the-bank/)

**Meta cancelled the second wave of its AI-driven restructuring.** Reuters reporting, relayed by IBTimes UK, says Mark Zuckerberg dropped the November phase of "Project OT" the night before the May layoffs, which still cut about 10% of staff. Internal data showed code changes up 220% year on year while features reaching users rose only 36%, and major incidents up 40%. Meta declined to comment on the figures. [IBTimes UK, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/meta-ai-restructuring-zuckerberg-cancels-layoffs-1816629)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-cisco-agent-90000-employees" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/cisco-agent-90000-employees/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Cisco is giving all 90,000 employees an AI agent, designed around token cost." markdown>

**Cisco is giving all 90,000 employees an AI agent, designed around token cost.** The rollout started with the new fiscal year at the end of July. CFO Mark Patterson says the system routes each request to the most efficient model ("It's not going to burn a whole bunch of tokens with frontier models"), runs largely on-premises, and that AI already writes 80–90% of the first draft of the MD&A in financial filings. Cisco does not disclose the cost. [Fortune, 1 Jul 2026](https://fortune.com/2026/07/01/cisco-cfo-ai-agents-finance-employees-mark-patterson/)

**EY and KPMG want juniors back in the office as AI takes over technical work.** EY's UK head of consulting, Sayeh Ghanbari, told the Financial Times that remote-heavy careers are "just not the route to success in the world of AI" and that flexibility will have to be reduced to build human skills. KPMG's UK advisory head made the same point about juniors learning directly from others. [Scottish Financial News, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.scottishfinancialnews.com/articles/junior-staff-to-return-to-office-to-sharpen-human-skills-as-ai-advances)

**The UK government awarded KPMG and EY up to £456m to train civil servants, AI included.** According to Tussell data cited by the Financial Times, it is the largest single Big Four contract since records began in 2012, covering 2026 to 2028. The figure is a ceiling, not committed spend, and the Cabinet Office says it covers training rather than consultancy. [Consultancy.uk, 27 Aug 2026](https://www.consultancy.uk/news/45443/government-hands-kpmg-and-ey-huge-contract-for-ai-training-of-civil-servants)

**IBM and OpenAI formed a consulting partnership.** Announced on 13 August, it embeds GPT-5.6, Codex and ChatGPT Work into IBM Consulting Advantage, IBM's delivery platform. IBM is also launching a dedicated OpenAI Practice with "thousands of consultants and engineers" and forward-deployed units working directly with clients. This is a vendor announcement. [IBM Newsroom, 13 Aug 2026](https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-08-13-IBM-Partners-with-OpenAI-to-Accelerate-Secure-AI-Deployment-for-Enterprises-Across-Core-Operations)
